title: zazzle-csharp-indexer settings
description: Settings read by the top-level files. The daemon's idle period is in src/Daemon/.dev/configuration.json, the run switch in src/Tools/.dev/configuration.json and the hook switch in src/Cli/.dev/configuration.json.

entities.title: State directory
entities.summary: Where store.db, the usage log, the daemon socket and config.json live.
entities.default: ~/Library/Application Support/zazzle-csharp-indexer on macOS; elsewhere $XDG_STATE_HOME/zazzle-csharp-indexer, or ~/.local/state/zazzle-csharp-indexer when XDG_STATE_HOME is unset or empty
entities.scope: per process; processes with the same value share a daemon and a store
entities.validation: An empty value is ignored; the directory is created when needed.

entities.title: Plain usage log
entities.summary: Keeps argument text readable in the usage log instead of hashing it.
entities.scope: the process that writes the record: the daemon (inherited from the process that started it), an in-process server, or the hook

entities.title: Serve without the daemon
entities.summary: Makes serve index and answer in its own process instead of connecting to the shared daemon.
entities.type: the string "1" (environment variable), or a flag
